verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Inngest has a REST API documented at api-docs.inngest.com. Nothing in the pack shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. A static API description is adjacent to this story, not the interactive, runnable reference it asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
